gdp_growth_forecast_pct.source_quote: Real GDP growth is projected at 3 percent in 2024 compared to an earlier projection of 3.7 percent.
gdp_growth_forecast_pct.note: Staff projection for 2024 real GDP growth.

headline_inflation_rate_pct.source_quote: Year-on-year inflation climbed to 0.6 percent by September 2024, rebounding from a low of -2.7 percent in December 2023.
headline_inflation_rate_pct.note: Latest observed headline year-on-year CPI inflation.

central_bank_policy_rate_pct.source_quote: The Central Bank of Seychelles (CBS) decreased the monetary policy rate (MPR) by 25 bps in March 2024 to 1.75 percent-the first rate change since a 100-bps cut in June 2021.
central_bank_policy_rate_pct.note: Current policy rate set by Central Bank of Seychelles.

non_performing_loan_ratio.source_quote: NPLs decreased from 8.1 percent in December 2023 to 7.2 percent in June 2024 but remain above the pre-pandemic average of about 3 percent.
non_performing_loan_ratio.note: Non-performing loans to gross loans ratio as of June 2024 (also shown in Table 5).
